description: This file contains partial class definitions and extension methods related to AdoNet reminder table options and their configuration within the Orleans framework. It includes configuration options, a validator class, and extension methods for setting up AdoNet reminder services in a silo builder.

classes.name: AdoNetReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for AdoNet reminder table, including connection string and invariant name.

classes.name: SiloBuilderReminderExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods to configure AdoNet reminder service within Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: UseAdoNetReminderService
methods.description: Extension methods to add AdoNet reminder service to Orleans silo builder or service collection, with various configuration options.
